content.short: Enclabs is a DeFi lending protocol giving users access to a range of borrowing and lending markets.
content.description: Enclabs is a decentralized lending protocol that gives users access to a range of borrowing and lending markets. DefiLlama lists it as a lending protocol on Plasma, where stablecoin supply makes lending markets one of the first primitives to appear.
content.meta: Enclabs is a DeFi lending protocol offering borrowing and lending markets, including on Plasma.
